headline.text: L2 panning discovered *Private Select* Mac nuts mislabeled as Costco; pallet on hold pending disposition—ML3 metal detector assembled incorrectly after cleaning.

summary: One active hold at L2 (allergen/product mislabeling). Two food-safety equipment gaps at L2 and L1. Multiple quality and temper control challenges on L1 S2.

holds.title: Private Select Mac nuts mislabeled as Costco
holds.summary: Panning crew discovered one pallet of 10140 Private Select macadamias labeled as Costco item; QA placed pallet on hold.

food_safety.title: ML3 metal detector assembled incorrectly after cleaning
food_safety.summary: Metal detector reassembled incorrectly following cleaning; discovered at 04:58 during startup checks and corrected before production resumed.

food_safety.title: Nut missing from S2 enrober tank, then recovered
food_safety.summary: Operator noticed one nut missing from caramel tank at 04:21; piece found 3 minutes later; line continued producing.

quality.title: S3 jar piece counts 20% above target at startup
quality.summary: First jars contained 52–54 pieces vs. target 46; shaker turned off and bottoming roller adjusted; counts returned to spec by 08:38.

quality.title: S2 mini temper unstable, multiple pauses
quality.summary: Mini temper failed to achieve stable temper 2nd shift; buffer tank at 95°F vs. 90°F setpoint; reheat cycle required; temper spiked again 1st shift, line paused.
quality.status: Open—line down at window close awaiting temper.

quality.title: MFM batch out of spec at startup
quality.summary: Batch not meeting specifications at line start; maintenance making adjustments.

quality.title: MFM best-by date format incorrect
quality.summary: Best-by date printed in wrong format; Kavin Ayala working on correction.

quality.title: Dark macadamias in panned final product
quality.summary: Darker nuts observed in reject bin and on final pallet; test confirmed sorter detects them; tote cleared for use.

quality.title: Truffle product lighter on south side vs. north
quality.summary: Operator noticed enrober shaker vibrating more on south side; product weight asymmetry; maintenance action created.

sanitation.title: Cleaning documentation missing for S2 lines
sanitation.summary: QA cannot locate production cleaning records for S2 enrober lines; post-clean ATP records exist in SafetyChain but production sign-off missing.

sanitation.title: Housekeeping gaps in Wrap Room areas 1 & 2
sanitation.summary: Paper towels on floor, buckets left on table (WR1); floor under shelf dirty (WR2).

allergen.title: S2 allergen filter not in place at startup
allergen.summary: Nut allergen filter missing during bed fill; operator installed filter before line ran product.

opportunities.text: Add allergen filter verification to S2 bed-fill startup checklist — based on today's missing filter at startup.
Review cleaning sign-off process for production teams — QA cannot locate S2 cleaning records despite ATP pass.
Consider buffer-tank temperature alarm or interlock on S2 mini temper — today's 95°F vs. 90°F setpoint caused hour-long temper failure.
Consider barcode or visual verification step for Mac nut totes at panning station — based on today's Private Select/Costco mislabeling catch.
Review ML3 metal detector reassembly checklist or add post-cleaning function test — based on today's incorrect assembly after cleaning.
